name: G1R TurboHotkeys Mod
description: Adds TURBO A, TURBO B, SAVE, LOAD and a second SELECT as rebindable rows on the game's own CONTROLS screen, and swaps the pad's A and B. Turbo mashes up to once per fixed step (60/s) with no added latency. Frees the shoulders and triggers from GAME SPEED so L1/R1/L2/R2 can be bound at all.
